channel.title: Server news — PaxVanila
channel.description: What happened in the world of PaxVanila each day. The Chronicler of the Monolith keeps the records: where the border grew, who founded a town, who declared war on whom and what the scholars found.

item.title: 📯 The landfall date is set
item.description: On this day the Chronicler received the order: the gates of the world open on 1 December at 20:00 (UTC+5, 18:00 Moscow time). Until that hour no foot will step inside the Monolith's circle. Whoever comes first picks the best land by the river.

item.title: 🌍 There will be two worlds
item.description: The cartographers mapped the first world block by block: the lake by the Monolith, the rivers and the mountains around it. Next to it lies a second map, of the real Earth. There Romea stands where Rome stood, Carthage on the Tunisian shore and the Horde on the steppe by Sarai. Both maps are on the site.

item.title: 🔥 The road to the Nether is charted
item.guid: pax-2026-11-19-The road to the Nether is charted
item.description: A third map was drawn beneath the world. One step below equals eight above, and the powers' portals are already marked. Under the Monolith itself lie the Great Gates. The Chronicler does not know who built them.

item.title: ⚖️ Gods, philosophers and courts
item.description: The priests wrote down the faiths and the sages their teachings. Each power picks a faith with /faith, and the faith grants its own strength. For disputes the /court is open, with a prison for those who break the law of PAX.

item.title: 📖 A menu without commands
item.description: For those who do not like typing commands, the craftsmen made a menu. Press G or Esc and the menu opens: town, nation, faith, focuses, court, war and caravans. Newcomers get a menu book on their first login.

item.title: 🗿 The Monolith speaks
item.description: The Hall of Five Lecterns opened in the tower at 0, 0. The word PAX and five lines of the oath are carved on the wall. Nobody can read the sixth line. Under the floor there is a hatch to the Roots, and the storeroom holds the Great Chronicle in twelve books.

item.title: ⛈️ The sky turned dangerous
item.description: PaxHydromet warns: cataclysms have come to the world. Storms, blizzards, droughts, earthquakes and meteors will arrive every 45–90 minutes. They will not harm newcomers in their first 48 hours or the tower at 0, 0. They say the weather on the Moon and Mars is even worse.

item.title: 🎞️ Records from the Far Sector
item.description: Guardian-7 found three records of the war for the Village in the archive, far beyond the world border. There were no rules there at all. From these records PAX took a law: war is declared 24 hours ahead, with a reason.

item.title: ⚓ Ships moored in the ports
item.description: Ports rose along the coast. At the piers stand the Seagull, the Copper Leviathan, the galleon Aurora Pax, the Golden Caravan and the Guardian-7. From the second week caravans with cargo will leave from here, and the whole server will know about each one.

item.title: 🏛️ Eight powers of antiquity
item.description: The chronicles named the powers of the Ancient World: the Holy Romean Republic, Carthage, the Germanic Union, Gaul, the Hellenic League, Dacia, the Great Steppe Horde and Scythia. Their lands are empty for now. Players will decide which of them come alive.

item.title: 🗼 The first stone
item.description: An old stone tower as tall as the mountains was raised at 0, 0. Every newcomer will start here. A border circle was drawn around it: 100 blocks on the first day, then it will grow every day.
